bio.text: Tom Barrett represents Michigan's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He served 22 years in the U.S. Army, including deployments to Iraq, Kuwait and Guantanamo Bay and service on the Korean DMZ.
He served four years in the Michigan House and four years in the Michigan Senate.
He graduated from Western Michigan University in 2007 through the Montgomery GI Bill and lives in Charlotte, Michigan.
